UPDATE vehicles SET
                number_plate = $2,
                description = $3,
                type = $4,
                availability = $5,
                model = $6,
                driving_license = $7,
                height = $8,
                length = $9,
                width = $10,
                weight = $11,
                provider = $12,
                additional_informations = $13,
                archived_at = $14,
                organization_id = $15
            WHERE id = $1
